quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to tuck in your blankets before breakfast"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: You do this right after you get out of bed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Making the bed means smoothing out sheets and fluffing pillows.
quests.funFact: A neatly made bed is extra cozy and inviting when it's time to sleep again!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Midday to fill your tummy halfway through your busy day"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: This meal happens in the middle of the day, not the morning or night.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat lunch in the middle of the day to refuel.
quests.funFact: Eating a balanced lunch can help you stay focused for your afternoon classes!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to put your clothes away neatly instead of on the floor"?
quests.question: Hang Up Clothes
quests.hint: This keeps your clothes neat instead of scattered on the floor.
quests.explanation: That's right! Hanging up clothes means using a hook or hanger to store them.
quests.funFact: Hanging up your clothes can help them stay neat and ready to wear again!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to care for a plant sitting near the window"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: A small watering can helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We water the plants so they stay green and healthy.
quests.funFact: Some houseplants only need a little water once or twice a week!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to move your body and breathe in some fresh air"?
quests.question: Play Outside
quests.hint: Fresh air, sunshine, and running are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We play outside in the afternoon to enjoy fresh air and exercise.
quests.funFact: Sunshine and fresh air can help you feel happy and full of energy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to snuggle up for a short bit of rest"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: This sleep is shorter than your nighttime sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! We take a nap in the afternoon to rest and recharge.
quests.funFact: Even grown-ups sometimes enjoy a short afternoon nap to feel refreshed!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to greet everyone with a happy, friendly hello"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: You say this cheerful greeting right after you wake up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say good morning to greet our family as the day begins.
quests.funFact: People around the world greet each other every morning in their own special way!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to hop aboard a big vehicle heading to class"?
quests.question: Ride the Bus
quests.hint: You wait at a special stop before this begins.
quests.explanation: Well done! The bus carries lots of students to school together.
quests.funFact: Riding the bus with friends is a fun way to start the school day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning and Night before you say hello or good night"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: You do this twice a day, not just once.
quests.explanation: That's right! Brushing our teeth keeps our smile clean and strong.
quests.funFact: Baby teeth need brushing too, even though new teeth will grow in later!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to sit down and enjoy cereal or eggs"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: A bowl of cereal or a piece of toast are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Breakfast is the first meal that helps us feel strong.
quests.funFact: Eating a healthy breakfast can help you feel focused during your first class!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to get the table ready before everyone sits down to eat"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: It helps get everyone ready to sit down and eat together.
quests.explanation: Well done! Helping set the table is a great way to help your family.
quests.funFact: Some families like to fold napkins into fun shapes when setting the table!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to enjoy a story before it's time to sleep"?
quests.question: Read a Book
quests.hint: This is a calm, quiet activity, often done before bed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Reading a story is a calm way to end the day.
quests.funFact: Reading before bed can help your mind relax and get ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to make your room dark and cozy for sleeping"?
quests.question: Turn Off the Light
quests.hint: Your room becomes dark and cozy right after this happens.
quests.explanation: That's right! Turning off the light helps our room get dark for bedtime.
quests.funFact: A dark room can help your body understand that it's time to sleep!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to end the day with warm, kind words"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: A hug or a kiss often comes along with these words.
quests.explanation: That's right! Saying good night is a warm way to end our day.
quests.funFact: Families all around the world have their own special way of saying good night!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to rinse away sleepiness before breakfast"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: Cool water and a little soap help with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash our face in the morning to feel fresh and clean.
quests.funFact: Cool water on your face can help you feel awake and alert in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to put on your favorite soft sleep shirt"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: These clothes are soft, comfy, and just for sleeping.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on pajamas at night to get cozy before bed.
quests.funFact: Many pajamas are covered in fun patterns like stars, stripes, or favorite animals!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to relax quietly in front of a screen for a bit"?
quests.question: Watch Some TV
quests.hint: A screen and a comfy couch are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We watch a little TV in the evening to relax.
quests.funFact: Watching a favorite show together can be a cozy family activity!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Anytime to fill your cup and take a refreshing sip"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: A cup or a bottle helps you do this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We drink water to keep our body cool and full of energy.
quests.funFact: Your body needs water to help you think, play, and grow every day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to lace up before you leave the house"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: Laces, velcro, or buckles help keep these snug on your feet.
quests.explanation: That's right! Shoes protect our feet for walking, running, and playing.
quests.funFact: Wearing the right shoes helps keep your feet safe while you run and play!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to organize your room so it feels calm and clean"?
quests.question: Tidy Your Room
quests.hint: This covers your whole room, not just one small pile.
quests.explanation: Yes! We tidy our room in the evening to keep it neat and calm.
quests.funFact: Tidying up a little bit each day keeps a big mess from building up!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to gather your homework and supplies for the day"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: You do this right before you walk out the door for school.
quests.explanation: Well done! A packed backpack helps us feel ready for a great school day.
quests.funFact: A backpack with both straps on your shoulders is comfier to carry all day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to care for your pet before school starts"?
quests.question: Feed the Pet
quests.hint: A food bowl and a happy, hungry pet are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We feed the pet in the morning so it has food for the day.
quests.funFact: Feeding a pet at the same time each day helps it feel safe and happy!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to put on something comfy for school or play"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: Buttons, zippers, and sleeves are all part of this task.
quests.explanation: That's right! Getting dressed means changing out of pajamas into daytime clothes.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a favorite color or uniform that students wear when they get dressed!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to soak in warm water before bedtime"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: Warm water, soap, and maybe some bubbles are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We take a bath to wash away the day's dirt and feel clean.
quests.funFact: Warm bath water can help your body relax and feel calm before bedtime!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to enjoy a quick treat like fruit or crackers"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: This is smaller than a full meal, just a little bite.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat a snack in the afternoon for a little extra energy.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make a healthy and tasty afternoon snack!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to rest your body after all your busy play"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: This is the very last thing you do before you fall asleep.
quests.explanation: That's right! Going to bed helps us get the sleep we need.
quests.funFact: Most children need about ten to twelve hours of sleep every single night!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to step outside and head toward your classroom"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: Holding a grown-up's hand can help keep you safe during this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Walking to school helps wake up our bodies before class.
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before crossing the street keeps you safe on your walk!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to fill your tummy before bedtime gets close"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: You often sit at a table with your family for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat dinner in the evening to enjoy a warm meal together.
quests.funFact: Sharing a meal together is a lovely time to talk about your favorite part of the day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to practice today's lesson a little more at home"?
quests.question: Do Homework
quests.hint: Your teacher usually gives this to you to finish at home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Homework helps us remember our lessons a little longer.
quests.funFact: Doing a little homework each day can help new lessons stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to warm your feet before you get dressed further"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: Your toes stay warm and cozy because of this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on socks comes right before putting on our shoes.
quests.funFact: Cozy socks can help keep your whole body feeling warm on a chilly day!
